scope: Read-only audit of immutable publisher sources and existing Runner artifact controls. No model or reference binary was executed.
sourceDigestMethod: SHA-256 over the complete raw HTTP response body from each immutable raw.githubusercontent.com URL.
publisherSourceObservations: The exporter accepts an arbitrary checkpoint directory and derives A factors from its unfolded tensors.
Its metadata writer omits checkpoint revision/digests and SSM input mapping.
The optional check examines only block zero, requires a bounded FFN control error and selects the lowest-error SSM mapping without an absolute SSM error ceiling.
The check compares unfolded stored columns without the native loader's SSM input permutation.
The publisher reports original Ternary Bonsai PTQ1 execution, not this Swift weight pack, and does not distribute its unfolded checkpoint.
closureRequirements: Obtain immutable checkpoint tensor/shard and conversion identities tied to the exact shipped adapter digest, including the direction tensor and normalization procedure.
Declare the authoring-to-native SSM channel mapping, transform/sign identities and runtime graph/loader identities for the intended Swift artifact.
Independently verify every shipped SSM A vector at all 48 sites against the declared inputs and mapping, with declared numerical bounds and retained per-site results.
Retain native writer inputs and corrections that independently validate application in that basis; matching final logits against the same native implementation is a separate gate.
Qualify no-adapter versus loaded-at-zero logits/state identity and scale-1.3 nonzero application on the intended released runtime; qualify scalar and explicit NEON independently.
Bind the evidence files, SHA-256 digests and independent reviewer identity into the promotion record and durable archive.
existingEvidenceCannotSubstitute: 129 matching target names/rank-one shapes establish structural compatibility only.
The one-token Auto native/Rust comparison at scale 1.3 establishes its recorded numerical scope only.
Changed text, successful adapter loading or zero-scale streaming alone establish neither authoring basis nor logits/state identity.
